notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
Updated the amount of enemies generated on missions from Bill.
Updated the Microwave Power Graphic
Updated the UFO
Added a few more SFX for various features in the game
Increased the size of the SuperPowers Buttons a bit
To land from flying you still need to Press the Wings Button to land from Flight
You Still Press "F" to fly, works good with W,A,S,D
If you don't already know Project Almighty 2 is in development and is coming along pretty well.
If you like This game you should like Project Almighty !
